title: nogat-job/1
description: A job of a server, the run of a command that can outlast a request (AGI-6.10, ECO-095, S6 of docs/plans/2026-11-24-latarnik.md): `POST /api/v1/jobs` with the body `$defs/start` answers `202`, `Location: jobs/<id>` and this document, which `GET /api/v1/jobs/<id>` answers until the job expires; `GET /api/v1/jobs/<id>/result` answers, once it has ended, what the command's synchronous route would. On Latarnik a job is the run of a flow, its tool `latarnik` and its command `flows <name>`. Projects copy this file like schemas/agent/ (ECO-050). Unknown fields are allowed: adding optional fields keeps the version (AGI-4.1).

id.description: At least 128 random bits in URL-safe characters (32 hexadecimal digits or 22 of base64url), the only way to the job: a server lists no other client's jobs

tool.description: The project in lower case as `<project>` of the standard, `latarnik` for a flow

command.description: The catalog command run, `<group> <verb>`; on Latarnik `flows <name>`

state.description: `queued` and `running` are active; `succeeded`, `partial` (some units failed, AGI-4.2), `failed`, `interrupted` (a restart of the server ended it) and `cancelled` are ended

progress.description: The units done and, where known, their total

started_at.description: Null until the job runs; a job cancelled while queued never starts

start.description: The body of `POST /api/v1/jobs`: the catalog command and its options, as its synchronous route takes them; the tool decides access from it as for that command (AGI-6.8)
